title: Complementary satisfaction counts for constant assignments
statement: Let $V$ be any set, and let $\mathcal C$ be a finite multiset of constraints, each requiring that the sum in $\mathbb F_2$ of the values on three distinct variables equal a specified right-hand side. The number of constraints satisfied by the assignment that gives every variable value $0$, plus the number satisfied by the assignment that gives every variable value $1$, equals the total number of constraints in $\mathcal C$.
hypotheses_covered: V is a type of variables
constraints is a finite multiset of E3Lin constraints on V
